# AI-related paths: the official list (constitution, Principle III).
# A pull request that changes any file matching a path below needs a passing
# AI test run before it can merge. Changes to this file need the project
# owner's approval (see .github/CODEOWNERS).
# Format: one path pattern per line. "**" means "everything inside this folder".
# Lines starting with "#" are comments.

# The AI clients (the answer AI and the grader)
src/lib/ai/**

# Prompts (the instructions given to the AIs)
src/lib/prompts/**

# Model choice (which AI models are used)
src/config/models.ts

# Label handling (getting, saving, and searching FDA labels)
src/lib/labels/**

# The personal-details scrubber (masks names, emails, phone numbers)
src/lib/scrub/**

# The emergency checks
src/lib/emergency/**

# The text matching the emergency checks use (typos, capitals)
src/lib/text/match.ts

# The order of the question steps (emergency first, scrub before any AI)
src/lib/pipeline/ask.ts

# Answer checks (word count, reading level, citations, dosing numbers)
src/lib/checks/**

# Refusal rules (dosing, comparisons, other drugs)
src/lib/refusals/**

# The GitHub workflows (the automatic checks: fast-tests, ai-tests, ai-gate,
# release). Changing them could switch off or weaken the checks themselves.
.github/workflows/**

# The script that runs the ai-gate check on every pull request
scripts/ai-gate.ts

# The code that decides if ai-gate and the release check pass or fail
src/lib/ci/**

# This list itself
.github/ai-related-paths.txt
